problem: A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin $O$ with acceleration, measured in $\text{m}/{\text{s}}^{2},$ given by the function $a(t)={t}^{1/3}-1,$ where $t>0$ is the time in seconds. If the particle has velocity $v=4\,\text{m}/\text{s}$ when $t=8\,\text{s},$ determine the moment in time when the particle is stationary.

activity_context.topic_title: Determining Characteristics of Moving Objects Using Integration
